name: Albescent-Brae
description: A single unbroken ocean swallows the horizon, its color shifting from wine-dark deeps to bright shelf-teal. The only interruptions are perpetual storm systems, breaking the swell in a ragged arc.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on exotic matter and biomass are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
